command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
R=chr20:1000000-3000000
T0=$(date +%s)
freebayes -f chr20.fa -r $R NA12878.chr20.30x.bam > out.vcf 2> fb.log
T1=$(date +%s)
N=$(grep -vc '^#' out.vcf || true)
{ echo "tool freebayes"; echo "region $R"; echo "wall_s $(( T1 - T0 ))"; echo "variants $N"; echo "mb_per_min $(awk -v s=$(( T1 - T0 )) 'BEGIN{if(s>0)printf \"%.2f\", 2.0/(s/60)}')"; echo "chr20_full_linear_min $(awk -v s=$(( T1 - T0 )) 'BEGIN{printf \"%.0f\", (s/2.0)*64.444/60}')"; } > canary.txt
cat canary.txt
tail -3 fb.log
test "$N" -gt 1000
echo CANARY_DONE
